title: The only weekly scoreboard that matters
caption: Save this. The only weekly scoreboard that matters. Not followers. Not hours in the chair.

scenes.text:
Save this.
The only weekly
scoreboard.
scenes.voice: Save this. The only weekly scoreboard that matters.

scenes.text:
Did you ship
something a stranger
could use?
scenes.voice: Number one. Did you ship something a stranger could use?
Number two. Did one person respond?
Number three. Did you write down what you will remake?
If all three are no, you were busy, not building.
If one is yes, do that again.

scenes.text:
Four weeks of this
beats a perfect plan.
scenes.voice: Four weeks of this beats a perfect plan.

scenes.sub: Watch again and count your week.
scenes.voice: Watch once for the list. Watch again and count your week.
